basis: Existing S2-2, S2-3, S2-4 and S2-5 requirements; no new scientific method, criterion or funding

cases.expect: any pilot and any authoring or selector conversation cannot forward its first output/strategy mutation before all mandatory complete original lossless evidence is model-visible
a normal direct final without a file mutation cannot bypass mandatory complete evidence; terminal and fallback remain explicit separate classifications
missing round2 prior-pool or earlier-author view in a later pilot rejects before a subsequent paid stage or solver rollout
missing anonymous candidate content in a later-pilot selector rejects normal completion, even when its choice ID is syntactically valid
saved-session replay recomputes and binds every normal session information proof to actual source instructions, signed requests, response and native candidate identity
selector id-map is the native deterministic assign_ids map for actual task_id, mode seq, k2, c1/c2 candidates, and chosen_id maps to chosen_label
a positive full genuine two-round mock path proves normal six-stage and selector delivery; a later-pilot omitted-view negative is rejected without changing the accepted information requirement
